## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering outcome.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant builds and focused checks pass.
- [ ] Runtime checks are listed separately from compilation/static review.
- [ ] Provider compatibility claims, if any, cite the applicable recorded Gate evidence.

## Privacy and security boundary

- [ ] No prompts, responses, DOM, credentials, cookies, tokens, payment data, or sensitive URLs are read, stored, or logged.
- [ ] Navigation, profile, persistence, packaging, and diagnostics changes fail closed where applicable.
- [ ] No signing material or secret was committed.

## Remaining risk

List unverified environments, provider-specific behavior, release gates, and follow-up work.
